item.title: Salah Bar 2.13.0
item.description:
• 🌍 Four new languages: اردو, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu and Français, alongside English, Türkçe and العربية (Settings → General → Language).
  • ✅ "Did you pray Asr?" An optional reminder when a prayer has not been ticked off, with a Prayed ✓ button (Settings → Reminders).
  • Turkish prayer notifications are now in Turkish.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.12.1
item.description:
• 🛠 Fixed: Salah Bar could close when switching to or from Arabic while the Quran window was open.
  • 👋 Set Salah Bar up before the welcome tour existed? The menu panel now offers it once.
  • In English, sources read "Quran 20:114", "Bukhari" and "Muslim".

item.title: Salah Bar 2.12.0
item.description:
• 🌕 The White Days: from the 12th to the 15th of each Hijri month, the panel shows the three moons and the hadith «إذا صمتَ من الشهر ثلاثة أيام فصُم ثلاث عشرة وأربع عشرة وخمس عشرة». One click turns on a reminder the evening before.
  • 🔔 Sunnah fast reminders now quote the hadith for the White Days, Mondays and Thursdays.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.11.0
item.description:
• 👋 A welcome tour that guides new users step by step: language, location, notifications and the adhan, and what is inside. Open it again from Settings → General.
  • 🌙 The hadith «الصلاة على وقتها» in the Amiri typeface.
  • 📍 No more preset cities (İzmir, Doha, Cairo): Salah Bar follows your location and you add the cities you want. Unused presets are removed; ones you use stay.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.10.0
item.description:
• ⚙️ New Settings window, laid out like System Settings: a sidebar of pages for General, Prayer Times, Iqama, Reminders, Adhan, Quran, Calendar and more.
  • 🌙 A new welcome with the hadith «الصلاة على وقتها»: "Prayer at its time" is the deed most beloved to Allah.
  • 📖 Hifz for six more recitations, with ayah-by-ayah audio from EveryAyah.com.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.9.1
item.description:
• 📅 Calendar: "Calendars to check" opens again, and turning prayer blocks off now says how many it removed.
  • 🗣 Siri: more ways to ask ("Salah Bar next prayer").

item.title: Salah Bar 2.9.0
item.description:
• 🕌 Iqama times for your mosque, with a countdown to the jama'ah.
  • ✅ Prayer log: tick off prayers, streaks, and an optional qada count.
  • 📅 Calendar: a warning when a meeting overlaps a prayer, and optional prayer blocks.
  • 🕋 Friday and Sunnah reminders: Al-Kahf on Fridays, Sunnah fasts, the last third of the night.
  • 📖 Hifz mode: repeat ayat with the Arabic text highlighted.
  • 🗣 Siri and Shortcuts.
  • 🔇 Other apps' music or videos pause during the adhan, then carry on.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.8.1
item.description:
• 🎙 Six new adhans, openly licensed and credited: the Prophet's Mosque in Madinah, the Great Mosque of Makkah, a Fajr adhan from Malmö, and recordings from Kazakhstan, the USA and Japan.
  • 🇹🇷 Turkish Hijri dates use Diyanet's month names ("24 Rebiülahir 1448 H.").
  • Clearer wording about your location: Salah Bar doesn't collect or share it.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.8.0
item.description: • 🧮 New prayer-time engine: Salah Bar now calculates the sun's position with its own code, built on the U.S. Naval Observatory's public formulas. Your prayer times stay exactly the same, to the second.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.7.3
item.description: • 🛠 Closing the lid stops the adhan: putting the Mac to sleep now stops the adhan and pauses the Quran, so they no longer carry on by themselves when you open it again.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.7.2
item.description: • 📖 Quran mini-player: click or drag its progress bar to jump anywhere in the surah, with the elapsed and total time under it.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.7.1
item.description: • 🛠 Large widget: for two minutes after each prayer begins, the card now says It's prayer time with that prayer and the ayah, and the next prayer as a small line. Before, it still said "Next prayer: Maghrib" while Asr was highlighted below.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.7.0
item.description:
• 📖 Listen to the Quran: 242 reciters, any surah. It streams by default; download surahs or a whole recitation to listen offline (on an external drive too).
  • Mini-player in the panel, media keys and Control Centre, resume where you stopped, repeat, sleep timer, favourites.
  • At prayer time the recitation fades out for the adhan, then carries on (Settings → Quran).
  • 🔕 Stop Flashing in the panel, or click the reminder, to stop the blinking before a prayer.
  • 🛠 Fixed a second adhan playing after stopping the first, when two copies of Salah Bar were open.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.6.2
item.description: Large widget fix: it could get stuck on a grey placeholder; it now prepares in about 2 seconds and refreshes reliably.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.6.1
item.description: Never miss an update: Salah Bar checks every 6 hours and tells you when a new version is out, with an Update Now banner in the panel and a notification.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.6.0
item.description: The right times wherever you are: the calculation method is now automatic by country. No wrong city when location is off, with an Allow Location button. 12-hour or 24-hour times (Settings → General).

item.title: Salah Bar 2.5.2
item.description: The Support Salah Bar button now opens Buy Me a Coffee: support by card or Apple Pay, no account needed.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.5.1
item.description: The Support Salah Bar button now opens the sponsorship page directly.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.5.0
item.description: A flash before the adhan: a soft green glow pulses around your screens when the warning starts, and the menu bar icon blinks until the adhan. Settings → Appearance → Flash warning (with Preview).

item.title: Salah Bar 2.4.2
item.description: Desktop widget: stays readable when macOS shows widgets faded or tinted, especially on light wallpapers.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.4.1
item.description: Salah Bar moved to github.com/be-liever95/salah-bar. Updates, the adhan library and the Support link use the new address; your settings and adhans carry over.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.4.0
item.description: Support Salah Bar: a new button in the menu panel and Settings → General. Salah Bar stays free and ad-free.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.3.1
item.description: Small fixes: the Arabic widget's Qibla distance shows the Arabic thousands separator, and Arabic adhan names display right-to-left in English and Turkish settings.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.3.0
item.description: Trim the adhan: choose exactly which part of any recording plays, with a waveform editor (✂︎ in Settings → Notifications). It fades out gently at your end point.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.2.0
item.description:
Add your own adhan: use any audio file, or pick from 169 adhans in the online library (Settings → Notifications → My adhans).

Arabic Qibla line fixes.

item.title: Salah Bar 2.1.0
item.description:
Arabic: the whole app, right to left, with Arabic-Indic digits (switchable).

A rotating ayah or dua: 42 ayahs, Quranic duas and hadiths in the menu panel and Large widget, changing every 15 minutes to once a day (Settings → Appearance).

item.title: Salah Bar 2.0.0
item.description:
The first native version of Salah Bar: one app instead of SwiftBar, Übersicht and a shell installer.

  • Menu bar countdown, prayer list, Hijri date and Qibla
  • Adhan with fade-in, reminders with a Silence button, quiet during calls
  • Desktop widgets in three sizes
  • Times calculated on your Mac and matched to the official Diyanet tables
  • Removes the old SwiftBar version for you
